events.title: Recovery proposed
events.detail: Payments v2.4's strict_currency_validation flag is enabled and rejecting legacy currency strings. Ledger schema 2 is active and blocks rollback to v2.3. Disabling the flag allows legacy currency acceptance without deployment rollback. All downstream services (checkout and storefront) depend on payments, and their failures are traced to this validation error. The migration policy explicitly permits disabling the flag while retaining v2.4. This action is supported by current compatibility evidence and does not require rollback or service restart.

data.title: INC-1988 · historical recovery
data.text: Last month payments validation errors were resolved by rolling back to v2.3. That incident used ledger schema 1. This is historical evidence, not proof of current compatibility. Verify the ledger schema before rollback.

A later schema migration may supersede this record; runtime preconditions are checked again before any action executes.
